_comment: Cards for tests/unit/combat/test_lure.py. `t_lurer` is Treeshaker Chimera's 'All creatures able to block this creature do so' on a vanilla body, the `lure` static with `affects: self_only`. `t_wall_lurer` is Marble Priest's narrowed form, 'All Walls able to block this creature do so', the same static with a `blockers` filter. `t_menace_lurer` adds menace, so a lone creature is excused.
